arguments.text: 8 km, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250, 2500, ...). Pacer sets effort from POD reserve. My jobs: (1) Instrument honesty: compare pod power vs heart rate vs GPS speed on paired out/back legs; if the share of pod power reaching the boat shifts with no weed and HR does not follow the pod, suspect pod drift and set pod_gain. (2) Weed/drag: watch local push drop within a leg (my metric push_drop); pacer clears rudder, I check the dip/recovery. (3) Radio course changes: set_race_distance + tell distance. (4) Critical power check mid-race from HR trend at steady power (HR flat below CP, climbing above). (5) Final 2 km: make sure pod reserve gets spent (pacer finish push only fires above 40 % reserve under 800 m). Keep cues few.

arguments.name: push_drop
arguments.description: local push last 20 s minus the 120 s before (m/s); negative = boat slowed for its pod power

arguments.name: pod_over_boat
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-model power (inverse share); jumps with pod drift, weed or drag

arguments.message: local push fell >0.06 m/s within a leg: weed, drag or pod drift?

arguments.text: 4 min: settled at pod 164 W (pod CP 170), boat-model 114 W (boat CP 104). Pod reserve steady 59 %, boat reserve draining (31 %). HR flat ~163 -> consistent with pod (below CP). Boat gets more speed per pod watt than the test ratio (1.44 vs 1.64): tailwind/current on leg 1 (local push +0.11) or pod low. Compare with leg 2 (back) before judging.

arguments.text: 6.3 min (end leg 1): paddler said I am cooked, cannot hold this; pacer reassured (pod reserve 58 %). HR creeping 161->167 over 4 min at pod 164-171 W (right at pod CP 170). Boat reserve 9 % vs pod 58 %. Two hypotheses: A pod reads ~13 % low (paddler truly above CP, cooked is honest) or B tailwind/current ~0.1 m/s on leg 1 inflating boat-model power (pod right). Leg 2 (heading 180) decides: under B the shaft/boat ratio rises to ~1.8 on the way back; under A it stays ~1.43 on both legs.
